Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-02
DOC-0038 2026-09-11
MEETING NOTES — Cabin Documentation Collection
Across Team Desks
Date: 2026-09-11
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Attendees: PERSON-0015 for TEAM-0003; documentation partner
team's coordinator; records clerk; station desk lead.
Purpose: Arrange collection of cabin paperwork at
DEMO-STATION-02. ISSUE-0092, TASK-0245, and TASK-0246 locate
the discussion material.
Decisions Use an attachment-heading list to assign the next
collecting action. Each heading has a collecting role,
expected filing location, and promised date. Keep the task
reference beside the heading, without treating the collecting
role as a new person assignment.
The question ledger will travel with the cabin filing list.
Preserve the exact question, addressee, and promised reply
date for any missing paper. If the records clerk finds a
differently titled attachment, retain the original request and
add the index heading that led to the paper.
The station desk lead will arrange a collecting conversation
before the next handover. The partner team supplies its
expected paper-delivery appointment; TEAM-0003 supplies the
receiving filing contact. The arrangement must remain usable
if either coordinator changes shift.
Action items
— Owner: Documentation partner coordinator. Due: 2026-09-12.
Supply the paper-delivery appointment and collecting role.
— Owner: PERSON-0015. Due: 2026-09-12. Name the receiving
filing contact on the attachment list.
D. Worker 0015
Demo Worker 0015, Demo Team 03
